name: vuh2628_safe_field_recovery04
description: Bounded dormant-script recovery fix: exact FM00 Script12 remains native-owned on both seats, flag40 independently1. Fixed4200ms Friend1 pause (VUH-2640 budget: under the relay 5000ms); require fresh authenticated native convergence/reset1 ACK/Arm. Single-PC loopback, same closure.

steps.expr: (log_count('[script-rc-cache] installed refresh=408520 winner=408BD0 accept=3B22D0',0)==1 and log_count('[script-rc-cache] installed refresh=408520 winner=408BD0 accept=3B22D0',1)==1) and all(log_count('[script-lifecycle] installed motionEnd=1 captureId=1 cancel=1 queryBudget=2048 cancelBudget=1024 captureBudget=512 changedOnly=1',i)==1 and log_count('[script-lifecycle] unavailable reason=',i)==0 for i in (0,1))
steps.message: Both seats must qualify existing RC-cache hooks, actual motion-end/capture-ID observers and sole cancel hook before any route input
Both real FM00 boots must be in identical full Serenity scope

steps.expr: log_count('[enemysync] client arrived epoch=',1)>0 and '[eventhold-control] armed ' in runtime_log(1)
all(not any(a.get('objectType') in (3,4,12) or a.get('objectId')==307 for a in actors(i)) for i in (0,1))
steps.message: The forced expiry fixture supports empty safe field only

steps.expr: all(b.get('localFramesPerSecond',0)>0 and (b.get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for b in saved['initial_avatars'])

steps.message: Both local unshared tutorial40 flags must already be set; fixture never changes them

steps.expr: all(log_count('[resync-ordinary] nativeOwnedDormant=1 raw=7 ordinary=6 ',i)>0 and (peek('0x9ABCB5','u8',i)&1)==1 for i in (0,1))
steps.message: Both native seats must positively qualify the complete mixed table and retain their own flag40
Recovered actual snapshot and both games must match the full original room

steps.expr: all(peek('0x9BA8D0','u8',i)==1 and peek('0x7435D0','u8',i)==255 and peek('0xB65210','u32',i)==0 and int(peek('0x2A11478','u64',i),16)==0 and peek('0x2A171E8','u32',i)==0 and peek('0xABB878','u32',i)==0 for i in (0,1)) and all(not any(a.get('objectType') in (3,4,12) or a.get('objectId')==307 for a in actors(i)) for i in (0,1))
all(b.get('localFramesPerSecond',0)>0 and (b.get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') and not (((b.get('puppet0') or {}).get('pose') or {}).get('flags',0)&8) for b in saved['recovered_avatars'])
steps.message: Both local avatar streams and remote puppet slots must be live after recovery
No late new-lifetime abort or scope drift during paired recovery film

steps.expr: all(peek('0x9BA8D0','u8',i)==1 and peek('0x7435D0','u8',i)==255 and peek('0xB65210','u32',i)==0 and int(peek('0x2A11478','u64',i),16)==0 and peek('0x2A171E8','u32',i)==0 and peek('0xABB878','u32',i)==0 for i in (0,1)) and all(not any(a.get('objectType') in (3,4,12) or a.get('objectId')==307 for a in actors(i)) for i in (0,1))
all(b.get('localFramesPerSecond',0)>0 and (b.get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') and not (((b.get('puppet0') or {}).get('pose') or {}).get('flags',0)&8) for b in saved['final_avatars'])
